# MiniGiantGames

> Independent studio building deep, replayable strategy and simulation games. Current project: Third Republic, a tactical space wargame.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Studio overview and currently active game.
- [Games](/games): All games in development and released.
- [Manual](/manual): In-app wiki and gameplay documentation for Third Republic.
- [Blog](/blog): Development updates and design notes.
- [Credits](/credits): People and tools behind the studio.
